title: 第十七章 百花婆婆第十八章 阴寒一剑
lines: “你师叔是谁？”
南宫飞烟眉头一皱，心道不好难，不成被人捷足先登了？
“嗖！”这一剑终于斩落一片雪花。
站在树下，王贤咯咯笑了起来。
苦苦修炼这些日子，终于斩落这风中雪花，想要让师父看看，怎奈大殿里坐着两个找麻烦的女人。
“东方霓裳啊，前辈你不认识我师叔？”
抬头一看，时已过午，肚子咕咕叫了。
王贤收了木剑，往不远处的灶房跑了过来，一边问道：“两位前辈要吃粥吗？”
“不吃！”
南宫飞烟闻言之下，哪里吃得下东西？
昆仑剑宗的东方霓裳，跟道观的老道士都是不出世的高人，一身修为并不在她之下。
她在想，倘若这剑要是落入东方霓裳手中，怕是麻烦了。
还没等王贤煮的粥出锅。
匆匆喝了两杯灵茶的南宫飞烟，带着师妹匆匆往北坡的昆仑剑宗而去。
一边跟王贤吩咐道：“小家伙，告诉你师父，我去剑宗逛逛，回头来再找他喝酒。”
王贤急着一头钻出灶房。
一脸烟尘意地喊道：“前辈我这煮了一大锅粥呢......”
“噗嗤！”
南宫芷兰忍不住笑道：“师姐，这小家伙心地不错，还给我们煮了粥呢！”
南宫飞烟摇摇头：“要不要我把他拐去东海，做你的徒儿？”
南宫芷兰嘻嘻笑了起来，远远跟王贤喊道：“小家伙，我姐姐要拐你去东海！”
王贤闻言一缩头，当即回道：“不去！”
南宫芷兰看了一眼姐姐。
哎哟，被一个筑基境的小家伙，嫌弃了。
买了一堆年货回山的老道士，听说东海来了两个女人，只是摇摇头，没有露出意外的神情。
而是告诉王贤，这些家伙倘若不来才奇怪。
第一次，王贤将神剑之事说了出来。
他相信之前师父不提，肯定是怕自己守不住这个秘密，想等他到了化神之境再说。
老道士闻言却吓了一跳。
看着他紧张地问道：“怎么回事？这是你师叔......不可能啊......”
“不是师叔！”
王贤静静地回道：“弟子在师叔的天书里的十年，有一个声音告诉我神剑之事......”
“原来如此，还好你没在她们师徒面前流露出来！”
老道士叹了一口气。
苦笑道：“说来话长，你跟那盘龙神剑自天外飞来，落在我的面前......而那剑鞘却陪伴了我无数年头......”
“记住，不到化神之境，千万不要尝试着去使用这把神剑！”
王贤嘿嘿一笑：“看来是师父替弟子遮挡了天机，否则师叔，跟那昨天两个老头，还有今天这两个女人......”
想到这里，王贤拍着胸口深深地叹了一口气。
无力地说道：“吓死我了！”
想想不对，只好又问道：“师父，东海来的两个女人说还会再来，弟子怎么办？”
老道士笑道：“有师父在，这事你不用操心。她们若是问你，便打死也不承认，还能怎么办？”
这一夜师徒两人都失眠了。
王贤想着眼看就大年三十了，还有人来找他们师徒的麻烦。
老道士躺在床上想不明白的是，自己的徒儿竟然只是在演化出神海之后。
content_en:
"Who is your uncle?"
Nangong Feiyan frowned and thought, maybe someone got there first?
"Whoosh!" This sword finally chopped off a snowflake.
Standing under the tree, Wang Xian chuckled.
After practicing hard these days, I finally cut off the snowflakes in the wind, and wanted to show the master, but there were two women sitting in the hall looking for trouble.
"Dongfang Nishang, senior, don't you know my uncle?"
I looked up and saw that it was already past noon, and my stomach was growling.
Wang Xian put away the wooden sword and ran to the kitchen not far away, while asking: "Do you two seniors want to eat porridge?"
"Don't eat!"
When Nangong Feiyan heard this, where could he get something to eat?
Dongfang Nishang of the Kunlun Sword Sect and the old Taoist priest of the Taoist temple are both unborn masters, and their cultivation is not inferior to hers.
She was thinking that if this sword fell into Dongfang Nishang's hands, she would be in trouble.
The porridge cooked by Wang Xian has not yet come out of the pot.
After hurriedly drinking two cups of spiritual tea, Nangong Feiyan took his junior sister to the Kunlun Sword Sect on the northern slope.
At the same time, he told Wang Xian: "Little guy, tell your master that I will go to Jianzong for a walk, and I will meet him for a drink when I get back."
Wang Xian hurriedly got out of the kitchen.
With a sultry look on his face, he shouted: "Senior, I have cooked a big pot of porridge..."
"Pfft!"
Nangong Zhilan couldn't help but laugh and said: "Senior sister, this little guy has a good heart and even cooked porridge for us!"
Nangong Feiyan shook his head: "Do you want me to kidnap him to the East China Sea and become your disciple?"
Nangong Zhilan burst into laughter and shouted to Wang Xian from a distance: "Little guy, my sister wants to abduct you to the East China Sea!"
Wang Xian shrank his head when he heard this and immediately replied: "I won't go!"
Nangong Zhilan glanced at her sister.
Oops, I was disliked by a little guy in the Foundation Establishment Realm.
...
The old Taoist priest who had bought a bunch of New Year's goods and returned to the mountains heard that two women had arrived from the East China Sea. He just shook his head and did not show any surprise.
Instead, he told Wang Xian that it would be strange if these guys didn't come.
For the first time, Wang Xian told the story about the Divine Sword.
He believed that the master had not mentioned it before because he was afraid that he would not be able to keep the secret and wanted to wait until he reached the state of becoming a god.
The old Taoist priest was shocked when he heard this.
Looking at him, he asked nervously: "What's going on? This is your uncle...impossible..."
"Not uncle!"
Wang Xian replied quietly: "During the ten years that I have been in my uncle's Heavenly Book, a voice told me about the Divine Sword..."
"I see, it's a good thing you didn't reveal it in front of their master and apprentice!"
The old Taoist priest sighed.
He smiled bitterly and said: "It's a long story. You and the Coiled Dragon Divine Sword flew from the sky and landed in front of me... but the scabbard has been with me for countless years..."
"Remember, don't try to use this divine sword until you reach the realm of divine transformation!"
Wang Xian chuckled: "It seems that the master has blocked the secret for the disciple. Otherwise, uncle, the two old men yesterday, and these two women today..."
Thinking of this, Wang Xian patted his chest and sighed deeply.
He said feebly: "It scared me to death!"
I thought something was wrong, so I had to ask again: "Master, the two women from the East China Sea said they would come again, what should I do, disciple?"
The old Taoist priest smiled and said: "Master is here, so you don't have to worry about this matter. If they ask you, they will kill you and refuse to admit it. What else can they do?"
This night both the master and the disciple suffered from insomnia.
Wang Xian thought that it would be New Year's Eve and there would still be people coming to trouble their master and apprentice.
What the old Taoist priest couldn't understand while lying on the bed was that his disciple had just evolved into the Divine Sea.
